title: Demand for AI infrastructure will drive more gains in this stock, says Bank of America
summary: CoreWeave is expected to benefit from strong AI infrastructure demand, strategic alliances, and its proprietary software, leading to a positive outlook from Bank of America and a strong year-to-date performance.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a positive outlook due to strong demand, strategic alliances, and the company's unique positioning in the AI market, despite a recent selloff due to weaker revenue guidance.
